body:
Remove all panels in blueprint.html are used, default values become constants in the code.

But we can still have configuration with 1 slider, that shows how many links will be shown.

By default links should fill square grid, for example, if we selected 8 links, links should be arranged in 3 by 3 grid, and 13 links will be in 4 by 4 grid. Meaning equal spacing for centers, all links centers are fixed and not movable as in blueprint. Each link by default should be rendered with start and end in itself, check self-referencing case in tests.html.

But we configure amount of links, not grid size.

So that is the only configurable parameter. We also should save user's layout to local storage, so it is not lost between restarts of page, and also we should give an ability to reset layout in control panel (make the button 100% width as a slider).

End result will be ability for the user to experiment with any layout of links he wants, and any number of them.

comments.body:
In grid.html for each separate link, use the same style we used in blueprint.html

I need to be able to snap links to each other and to themselves, meaning all interactive features on the SVG canvas should just work.

Check for style of control points, in https://github.com/konard/links-visuals/pull/24 I asked them to have different colors, but clearly the edge style (dashed), no fill like in blueprint.html for control points should be applied.

They should they should look and behave like in blueprint.html (we can omit rendering of intermediate points as they are not interactive, and clearly we need different colors, as we display many of them).

Carefully read https://github.com/konard/links-visuals/pull/24#issuecomment-4077548850 and other requirements we discussed.

What so hard is to copy existing code, and not to rewrite it too much?

Grid layout should be like in https://github.com/konard/links-visuals/pull/24 (square grid). Colors selection also. Link centers not movable.

Style of control points should be exactly as it was in blueprint.html, no size of border should change, only color.

Start and end control points should be above the center of the link, just like it was in blueprint.html. Please try to reuse as much code from blueprint.html as possible regarding the SVG canvas, the link on it and so on.

Please read all requirements again from this issue and both pull requests.

If you don't understand what I'm talking about write how did you understand me, and ask questions to clarify.

title: Take best practices from blueprint.html, to make grid.html
